observation.visible_scene: Close-up of a beige/cream sink basin. A thin stream of water pours down from the top edge onto a translucent, gel-like or plastic-film mass that covers the metal drain at the lower right; a crumpled shiny plastic piece sits at the drain opening. The left basin wall is wet, with scattered droplets and bright reflections. A blurry blue-gray object occupies the lower-left foreground, and a blue bottle with white lettering is partly visible at the top-left edge.
visible_changes: The water stream is continuous throughout, striking the upper part of the translucent mass and producing small splashes and shifting specular highlights.
The translucent mass mostly holds its shape but shows minor surface deformation and moving highlights as water flows over it.
The overall framing drifts slightly from frame to frame (small camera pan/tilt), shifting the drain, stream, and wet wall within the view.
Near the end of the segment the blue bottle at the top-left edge becomes progressively more visible/shifts into view.
The blurry lower-left foreground object stays roughly in place, but its position relative to the frame edges changes with the camera drift.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the water flow starts or stops outside this excerpt (it is already flowing at the first frame and still flowing at the last).
The identity of the translucent mass (plastic bag, gel, or film) and how it came to cover the drain.
Whether the top-left bottle change is due to camera motion or an unseen hand moving the bottle.
Any outcome after the segment (e.g., drain clearing or not).
uncertain_details: Cause of the top-left bottle's increasing visibility (camera pan vs. object movement).
Exact nature of the blurry lower-left object (finger/hand vs. out-of-focus item).
Whether the translucent mass is slowly spreading/expanding or only deforming under the stream.
